capabilities: hide the cursor when scrolling up or down
hide the cursor after an idle delay
show the cursor again when the mouse moves
configure timing values in the settings
extras: README is minimal; no screenshots or usage examples, but installation steps for both the plugin store and manual install are included.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hide the mouse cursor, which can distract while reading or focusing on a note.

relations.evidence: A nice complementary plugin to obsidian-focus-mode.
Similar to the chrome extension Hide mouse pointer

summary: Mouse-cursor hider that conceals the cursor while scrolling or after an idle delay and shows it again when the mouse moves.
